color-scheme.$description: The app scheme for system elements (scroll bars, input fields, the selection menu). There is one theme, dark (the graphite palette, ADR-0004), so the browser must draw system elements in the dark variant: without it the scroll bars are light on a dark background (KINIG-38). base.css puts this value into `color-scheme` on html; it does not break the transparency of the capture window (the corners are transparent on macOS 15 and 26, docs/screens/kinig-40). `$type` is not set: DTCG has no type for a keyword, and a foreign type (like `string`) would be wrong. When a light theme appears, the value moves into the palette.
